name: Documents as Markdown
description: A document or a book read as text rather than laid out as pages — Word's .docx and older .doc, EPUB, and FictionBook (.fb2 and .fb2.zip): headings, lists, tables, notes, comments and pictures, with the fonts, the page breaks, the headers and the footers thrown away. A book's headings come from its own contents when its pages do not mark them. The page as it was set is one Enter away.
author: xverb

settings.note: Nought shows all of it. A limit cuts at the end of a line rather than mid-word, and the reading says it was cut.
